admission.justification: Weighed alternative challenge-file classification, timestamping and local-verification designs and constrains downstream validator and site banner schemas.

alternatives.option: Classify both src/Challenge.lean and comparator/FormalConjecturesChallenge.lean as role='challenge' (7 challenge sorrys total), hard-code build_status='unverified-locally' in Phase 0, and omit all wall-clock timestamps from emitted audit JSON.
alternatives.reason: Matches the actual upstream comparator/ layout without misreporting comparator challenge sorrys as solution findings, keeps epistemic status honest when Lean is not executed, and guarantees deterministic byte-identical regeneration for git diff --exit-code audit/.

alternatives.option: Classify only src/Challenge.lean as role='challenge' (5 sorrys) and emit wall-clock generation timestamps or an invented local kernel-receipt format.
alternatives.reason: Misclassifies the two sorrys in comparator/FormalConjecturesChallenge.lean as solution failures, breaks deterministic regeneration on every run, and risks overstating verification status without an executed Lean kernel check.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Upstream removes comparator/FormalConjecturesChallenge.lean or a future approved requirement replaces byte-identical committed audit snapshots with signed timestamped build receipts.

alternatives.option: Execute Lake/Lean locally during Phase 0 auditing to emit build_status='verified' with kernel-check receipts.
alternatives.reason: Out of scope for Phase 0 deterministic metadata/static-scan auditing, which must run without executing Lean or mutating upstream checkouts.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A future approved requirement adds a reproducible local or CI Lean kernel-verification pipeline and defines a formal receipt schema.

consequences: Downstream validators and the site verification banner consume deterministic, timestamp-free JSON with build_status='unverified-locally' and challenge_sorry_count=7 across both challenge files.
Introducing verified local or CI Lean kernel receipts requires a later approved requirement revision that extends BuildStatus and the audit schema.
context: Phase 0 emits machine-generated audit JSON committed in the repository for downstream validators and the public site banner without running Lean locally; the pipeline had to classify upstream comparator challenge files accurately, represent unverified local build status honestly, and guarantee byte-identical regeneration.
